items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Jesse was used on it because Milt couldn't pay for his vibes to be shipped to Paris.

ctx.x: So this band you had with the Heath Brothers... It had Jesse Powell on tenor?

Yeah. Well, Jesse was used on it because Milt couldn't pay for his vibes to be shipped to Paris. Instead of going over there and renting some, we didn't think about that, you know... I told Milt, "Well, if they won't pay your transportation for the vibes, I can't take you, because I can't afford to pay for the vibes." Had we known, we could have rented some from over there, and we could have still took the band intact. But I wasn't thinking too bright, I guess, in those days. I know Milt wasn't thinking at all.…
